description: [Compliance & counterparty] Check a new supplier before onboarding or paying it, in one call. Use when onboarding or paying a new supplier. Price: $0.25 per call (USDC on Base, x402). Returns the x402 payment requirements unless payment_signature is given. Sample: /samples/supplier-check

country.description: Optional ISO 3166-1 alpha-2 country of the supplier, e.g. DK, DE, NO

eori.description: Optional EU EORI number, e.g. DE123456789012345

lei.description: Optional 20-character LEI to identify the company exactly

payment_signature.description: Optional x402 v2 PAYMENT-SIGNATURE value, relayed unchanged to the endpoint. Omit to receive the payment requirements.

vat.description: Optional EU VAT number with country prefix, e.g. DK24256790

name: supplier_check
title: Supplier Check (VAT, EORI, Company, Sanctions, Export Control) ($0.25)
